expected.raw_text: Certifications: Microsoft Azure, GitHub, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevOps

parsed.seniority_signal: 7+ years in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline.
parsed.degree_signal: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
parsed.notes:
Required Education, Required Certification, and Required Skills & Experience are required sections; Nice-to-Haves is optional and ends at the subsequent company/role narrative. Responsibilities-only technologies are excluded.
The unmarked stack makes Bicep, Bash, PowerShell, Helm, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and other repeated technologies required despite earlier alternatives or optional mentions.
Microsoft Foundry is mapped to the renamed Azure AI Foundry product. Distinct Azure products without matching taxonomy entries remain unmapped rather than being reduced to their underlying vendor or general capability.
Model and endpoint operations is interpreted as MLOps; this mapping is flagged. GenAIOps is interpreted as LLMOps and flagged. Agent evaluation is treated as asking for agent expertise as well as evaluation and is flagged.
The slash in Snowflake/Databricks is read as an alternative familiarity ask; both criteria are flagged because the guide does not explicitly define slash-separated alternatives.
Alternative group 1 contains the remaining mapped experience alternatives; platform engineering and site reliability engineering are unmapped, and DevOps is independently required. Group 3 contains the remaining mapped deployment alternatives; agents and RAG are independently required.
Certification alternatives have no surviving multi-skill mapped group after independently required skills are removed. Helm is independently required, so Argo CD has no alternative group. The optional observability-product alternatives are unmapped except Azure Monitor, which is independently required.
Logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and alerting are represented by observability; regression testing is represented by testing. Prompt/configuration/agent versioning is not silently mapped to model versioning.
Financial-services knowledge, regulated-industry experience, communication, spoken languages other than German, and years of experience are not skill criteria.
